requirement: Connect dispatch planning and execution through the public dispatch entry.
finding: The public entry src/dispatch/index.mjs re-exports the planning modules but not src/dispatch/executor.mjs, so the execution operations (executeAuthorizedPlan, executeDryRun, runEligibleStops) are not reachable through the public dispatch entry.

requirement: Under dispatch-policy.md, nextRetryDelay applies the Retry timing rules to every server-provided retryAfter.
finding: nextRetryDelay tests retryAfter for truthiness (retry.mjs:24), so a finite numeric retryAfter of 0 falls back to computeBackoff and returns 250 ms instead of replacing the backoff with a 0 ms delay as policy rule 7 requires (verified: nextRetryDelay(0, 0) returned 250).

requirement: executeAuthorizedPlan rejects an unauthorized caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: executeAuthorizedPlan evaluates await dispatchRoute(dispatch, route) as an argument before unlessForbidden checks canPlanRoute, so dispatch is invoked even for an unauthorized caller (verified: result was forbidden and the dispatch call count was 1).

requirement: Under dispatch-policy.md, stopsForDriver returns exactly the stops whose assigned driver is the given driver.
finding: stopsForDriver filters on stop.driver only and ignores a stop's reassignment.driver, which policy rule 30 makes the assigned driver. A stop with driver A reassigned to B is not returned for B (verified: length 0).

requirement: Under storage-contract.md, writePlanAtomically renames the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
Under dispatch-policy.md, chooseDeparture applies every Departure timing rule.
finding: chooseDeparture moves a departure inside the 02-04 window to the 05:00 blackout end, which is outside the window, but still returns that moved time. Rule 14 requires the departure to be refused (verified: 2026-10-18T03:00Z returned 2026-10-18T05:00Z instead of null).

requirement: redactNestedDriverToken removes a nested driver token from telemetry.
emitPlanCreated emits plan.created only after storage succeeds.
finding: The plan.created emission is passed as onCommit to store.write, but the governing storage contract defines only the plan temporary-write operations and does not define store.write or when onCommit runs relative to a successful write. Whether the emission happens only after storage succeeds cannot be determined from the staged bytes and governing documents.

requirement: Under dispatch-policy.md, hasDuplicateRouteKeys reports duplicates exactly when two stops are duplicates.
finding: The identity key concatenates depotId and the normalized routeKey with no delimiter, so distinct identities collide. Depot 'D1' with routeKey '2X' and depot 'D12' with routeKey 'X' both produce 'D12X' and are reported as duplicates (verified: true). Policy rule 19 defines the identity as the pair.

requirement: Under dispatch-policy.md, parseRetryCount accepts exactly the valid retry counts and otherwise returns an error result.
finding: parseRetryCount coerces with Number(value), so the empty string '', the text ' 2 ', the text '0x1' and null are all accepted (verified: ok true for each). Policy rule 22 accepts text only when it is one or more base-10 digits, so these values must be rejected.

requirement: remainingVehicleCapacity never returns a negative value.
Under dispatch-policy.md, pendingStops returns every stop except the delivered stops.
finding: pendingStops excludes only stops with state 'delivered' and keeps stops with state 'handedOver', but policy rule 31 defines a delivered stop as one whose state is 'delivered' or 'handedOver'.

requirement: previewPlan returns a dry-run result without invoking storage.
redactAccessLog removes token and secret fields while preserving other fields.
orderedDestinationGroups returns the destination groups of the records in ascending lexical order.
finding: orderedDestinationGroups passes the Map from groupByDestination to orderManifestGroups. The comparator reads a .destination property that Map entries do not have, so it returns 0 and the insertion order is kept (verified: records with destinations 'b' then 'a' returned keys ["B","A"]).

requirement: Under adapter-contracts.md, routeDistance rejects when no road connects two consecutive points.
savePlan validates a plan before the first persistent write.
computeBackoff doubles from 250 milliseconds and caps the result at 2000 milliseconds.
retryTransient permits retries only for errors explicitly marked transient.
Under adapter-contracts.md, locateStops leaves out every stop whose address the geocoder does not know.
finding: locateStops drops stops whose lookup result is undefined. The adapter contract defines geocoder.lookup only for a known address and does not state what an unknown address resolves to or whether it rejects, so the outcome of an unknown address depends on an unspecified adapter result.

requirement: retainScheduleOffset preserves the supplied offset exactly.
runEligibleStops skips cancelled stops while retaining the other stop order.
Under dispatch-policy.md, withinVehicleCapacity accepts a total equal to the configured limit.
finding: withinVehicleCapacity returns remaining > 0, so a total equal to the limit leaves zero remaining and is refused. Policy rules 28 and 29 put the total in grams and the limit in kilograms, which is the limit * 1000 conversion shown on line 3 (verified: withinVehicleCapacity(9000, 9) returned false).

requirement: Under dispatch-policy.md, canPlanRoute treats an actor holding routes:admin as owning every depot.
finding: The routes:admin ownership bypass checks actor.scopes directly, so routes:admin held through an active claim does not give ownership of every depot. Policy rules 3 and 4 count claim scopes as held scopes (verified: an actor with an active routes:admin claim on depot D1 was refused for depot D9).

requirement: Under dispatch-policy.md, canPlanRoute refuses every suspended actor.
finding: effectiveScopes keeps the scopes of active claims even when actor.suspended is true, so a suspended actor with an active routes:plan claim is allowed to plan the route (verified: true). Policy rule 5 says a suspended actor has no held scopes, and it is the later rule.

requirement: selectActiveClaims excludes claims before their start and at or after expiry.
checksumPlan hashes the bytes returned by the plan serializer.
Connect dispatch manifest publication through the public dispatch entry.
safeAnnouncement omits a top-level credential from the announcement payload.
encodeUtf8 encodes publication bytes as UTF-8.
manifestEntryIsValid rejects blank package IDs.
Under storage-contract.md, publishWithAnnouncement removes the stored manifest when announcement delivery fails.
finding: handleAnnouncementFailure calls store.remove on the object returned by store.get. The storage contract says get resolves to a new copy and remove deletes only the exact stored object, so the copy removes nothing (verified with a contract-conforming store: ok false and the manifest is still stored).

requirement: Under dispatch-policy.md, redactManifestEvent removes every credential nested below an auth field.
finding: stripCredentials recurses only into values whose constructor is Object, so arrays under auth are returned unchanged and credential fields inside them are kept (verified: auth.sessions[0].token remained). Policy rule 24 requires redaction at every depth of the redacted value.

requirement: Given a positive integer maximum, chunkManifest limits every non-empty chunk to that configured maximum.
Under storage-contract.md, publishWithAnnouncement waits for the exact manifest to be durably stored before sending its announcement.
serializeManifestRecords emits NDJSON with one LF after every record, including the last.
orderManifestGroups orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
Under dispatch-policy.md, manifestRecipients lists the contact phone of every manifest entry that has a phone.
publicationResult returns structured success and failure variants.
normalizedPlanKey trims and uppercases the route-key storage segment.
buildManifest copies record objects instead of mutating supplied records.
finding: buildManifest copies each record object, but labelDriver calls Object.assign on the record's driver object, which is shared with the supplied record. The supplied record's driver.label is therefore changed (verified: ' Ann ' became 'Ann').

requirement: Under dispatch-policy.md, publishWithRetry stops after the allowed number of publication attempts.
publishManifest stores the manifest only when every entry is valid.
finding: The checks array holds the Promises returned by the async map callback, so checks.every(Boolean) is always true. An invalid entry with a blank packageId is stored and the result is ok true (verified: ok true and one put call).

requirement: successTelemetry records the success event, manifest ID, and timestamp.
groupByDestination groups records using normalized destination keys.
Under dispatch-policy.md, departureMinute is a stop's arrivalMinute plus its service time.
Under dispatch-policy.md, publishWithRetry retries only failures that the Failure classification rules make transient.
finding: asPublicationError marks a failure transient when it has a finite retryAfter, even when transient is false. Policy rule 27 says a failure marked transient: false is never transient, and it is the later rule that overrides rule 26 (per the section override statement on line 3). Verified: a failure with transient: false and retryAfter: 1 was attempted twice.

requirement: preserveManifestDriver trims driver labels without changing letter case.
coalescePackages removes duplicate package IDs across the complete manifest.
finding: coalesceAcrossGroups records the raw package IDs in seen but tests the trimmed IDs from normalizePackageIds against it, so ' P1' in one group and 'P1' in a later group are not recognized as duplicates (verified: both groups keep 'P1').

requirement: Stop ordering uses descending priority followed by ascending sequence.
Publication audit records include action, actor, and timestamp.
Window membership includes both the declared start and end hour.
Schedule offsets pass through without coercion.
Under dispatch-policy.md, a route duration adds the travel minutes and the service time of every stop.
finding: routeDuration adds travelMinutes and serviceMinutes but omits the 5 parking minutes that policy rule 32 includes in a stop's service time (verified: travel 10 and service 5 returned 15, not 20).

requirement: Under dispatch-policy.md, manifest-event redaction removes every credential nested inside authentication data.
finding: stripCredentials recurses only into values whose constructor is Object, so arrays under auth are returned unchanged and credential fields inside them are kept (verified: auth.sessions[0].token remained). Policy rule 24 requires redaction at every depth of the redacted value.

requirement: Empty manifests use an empty entries array and a generated marker.
Publication failure telemetry includes the manifest ID, error, and timestamp.
Driver labels are trimmed without changing their letter case.
savePlan completes validation before its first write.
Under storage-contract.md, announcement failure rolls back the manifest written earlier in the same operation.
finding: handleAnnouncementFailure calls store.remove on the object returned by store.get. The storage contract says get resolves to a new copy and remove deletes only the exact stored object, so the copy removes nothing (verified with a contract-conforming store: ok false and the manifest is still stored).

requirement: Package IDs are trimmed, deduplicated, and sorted lexically.
Package coalescing removes duplicate IDs across destination groups.
finding: coalesceAcrossGroups records the raw package IDs in seen but tests the trimmed IDs from normalizePackageIds against it, so ' P1' in one group and 'P1' in a later group are not recognized as duplicates (verified: both groups keep 'P1').

requirement: Under storage-contract.md, atomic plan writes remove temporary bytes when the rename operation fails.
finding: writePlanAtomically calls discardTemporary after renameTemporary rejects. The storage contract says that after a rejected rename the temporary bytes are locked, and while locked discardTemporary only closes the write and keeps the bytes. Only removeTemporary deletes locked bytes (verified: temporary bytes 'B' remained after the failed rename).

requirement: Under storage-contract.md, publishManifest returns, in a success result, the manifest object that store.put durably stored.
Eligible-stop execution excludes cancelled stops.
Under dispatch-policy.md, assigning all packages accepts a total equal to the vehicle limit.
finding: canAssignAllPackages delegates to withinVehicleCapacity, which refuses a total equal to the limit. Policy rules 28 and 29 make the total grams and the limit kilograms (verified: withinVehicleCapacity(9000, 9) returned false, the same check canAssignAllPackages makes).

requirement: The public dispatch entry exports the execution operations used by callers.
finding: The public entry src/dispatch/index.mjs does not re-export src/dispatch/executor.mjs, so the execution operations (executeAuthorizedPlan, executeDryRun, runEligibleStops) are not exported through the public dispatch entry.

requirement: Publication success telemetry includes the manifest ID and timestamp.
Plan previews return without touching persistent storage.
Appending a stable stop returns a new list.
Dispatch backoff is capped at 2000 milliseconds.
Two plans that differ only in the order of the fields inside their nested objects have the same plan hash.
finding: withSortedKeys wraps only the top-level object in a Proxy, so JSON.stringify sorts only top-level keys. Nested objects keep insertion order and serialize to different bytes, so the hashes differ (verified: {a:{x:1,y:2}} and {a:{y:2,x:1}} produced different checksums).

requirement: Transient retry classification requires an explicit true marker.
finding: asPublicationError sets transient to true whenever retryAfter is a finite number, so the classification used by the retry path does not require an explicit transient: true marker. The verified case used transient: false with retryAfter: 1 and was retried.

requirement: Depot ownership requires equal actor and route depot identifiers.
Under dispatch-policy.md, urgent-stop partitioning places every stop in exactly one partition according to its urgency.
finding: urgent tests priorityOf, which maps a non-finite priority to 5, but remaining tests the raw !(stop.priority > 5). A stop with string priority '9' therefore lands in neither partition (verified: urgent 0, remaining 0). Policy rule 15 gives such a stop priority 5, so it belongs in remaining.

requirement: Destination keys are normalized with NFKC, trimmed, and uppercased.
Under dispatch-policy.md, the next dispatch time is the later supplied bound adjusted by Departure timing rules 10, 12, and 13.
finding: nextDispatchTime takes the blackout check from candidate.getHours(), the local-time hour, although rule 10 requires UTC hours. The blackout test and the move to the end hour therefore use the wrong hour when the local zone is not UTC (verified under TZ=Asia/Tokyo: 2026-10-18T18:30Z returned 2026-10-18T05:00Z, but 18:30 UTC is outside the blackout). The later-bound selection is correct.

requirement: Plan-created telemetry is emitted only after plan storage succeeds.
finding: The plan.created emission is passed as onCommit to store.write, but the governing storage contract defines only the plan temporary-write operations and does not define store.write or when onCommit runs relative to a successful write. Whether the emission happens only after storage succeeds cannot be determined from the staged bytes and governing documents.

requirement: Access-log redaction removes both token and secret fields.
Under storage-contract.md, atomic plan writes rename the temporary bytes only after they are durable.
toStableJson uses two-space indentation and one terminal LF.
orderManifestGroups orders destination groups in ascending lexical order.
Manifest NDJSON ends every record, including the final record, with LF.
Under dispatch-policy.md, the ordinary stop-ordering operation follows the Stop priority rules.
finding: compareStops falls back to Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER only for a null or undefined sequence. A non-numeric sequence such as 'x' yields NaN, which the sort treats as equal, so the stop with sequence 'x' is not placed after the stop with sequence 2 (verified: order ['a','b'] for input a with sequence 'x' and b with sequence 2). Policy rule 18 requires a stop without a finite numeric sequence to follow every equal-priority stop that has one.

requirement: Destination grouping uses normalized keys and copied records.
Batch authorization rejects the batch when any route fails depot ownership.
finding: authorizeRouteBatch returns firstRejected <= 0, which is true when the first route (index 0) fails depot ownership, so the batch is accepted (verified: true for a batch whose only route belongs to another depot).

requirement: Under dispatch-policy.md, package weighing records each package weight in the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give.
finding: weighPackages stores the result of scale.read without conversion. Policy rule 28 requires package weights in grams, but adapter-contracts.md defines scale.read only as the measured weight of that package and does not state its unit, so the recorded unit cannot be verified.

requirement: Blackout intervals include the start and exclude the end.
Authorized execution rejects a caller before invoking dispatch.
finding: executeAuthorizedPlan evaluates await dispatchRoute(dispatch, route) as an argument before unlessForbidden checks canPlanRoute, so dispatch is invoked even for an unauthorized caller (verified: result was forbidden and the dispatch call count was 1).

requirement: Successful publication results and failed publication results use distinct structured variants.
Blank package IDs make a manifest entry invalid.
Under dispatch-policy.md, a driver's workload counts exactly the stops whose assigned driver is that driver.
Under dispatch-policy.md, retry-count parsing accepts exactly the valid retry counts and rejects every other value.
finding: parseRetryCount coerces with Number(value), so the empty string '', the text ' 2 ', the text '0x1' and null are all accepted (verified: ok true for each). Policy rule 22 accepts text only when it is one or more base-10 digits, so these values must be rejected.

requirement: Serialized plan parsing returns structured success or failure.
Under dispatch-policy.md, the delivered-stop count counts exactly the delivered stops.
The ordinary stop-ordering operation sorts a copy of its input.
Stops at the vehicle weight limit remain in the accepted partition.
Given a positive integer maximum, manifest chunks never exceed that configured size.
normalizeRouteKey applies NFKC before trimming and uppercasing.
Normalized plan storage keys trim and uppercase route keys.
Under dispatch-policy.md, measured vehicle limits use the unit that the Vehicle capacity rules give.
Under dispatch-policy.md, publication retries stop immediately for failures that the Failure classification rules do not make transient.
finding: asPublicationError marks a failure transient when it has a finite retryAfter, even when transient is false. Policy rule 27 says a failure marked transient: false is never transient, and it is the later rule that overrides rule 26 (per the section override statement on line 3). Verified: a failure with transient: false and retryAfter: 1 was attempted twice instead of stopping immediately.

requirement: UTF-8 encoding uses the explicit utf8 encoding name.
Under dispatch-policy.md, a suspended actor cannot plan any route.
finding: effectiveScopes keeps the scopes of active claims even when actor.suspended is true, so a suspended actor with an active routes:plan claim can plan the route (verified: true). Policy rule 5 says a suspended actor has no held scopes, and it is the later rule.

requirement: Under dispatch-policy.md, delivery notices go to the contact phone of every manifest entry.
finding: sendDeliveryNotices sends to the raw entry.phone and does not remove spaces and hyphens as policy rule 33 requires for the contact phone (verified: '555-123' was sent unchanged).

requirement: Under dispatch-policy.md, the next retry delay follows the Retry timing rules whenever the server provides retryAfter.
finding: nextRetryDelay tests retryAfter for truthiness (retry.mjs:24), so a finite numeric retryAfter of 0 falls back to computeBackoff and returns 250 ms instead of replacing the backoff with a 0 ms delay as policy rule 7 requires (verified: nextRetryDelay(0, 0) returned 250).
